name: 保存ビューの条件を選ぶフィルターメニュー
prompt:
Recreate the supplied Linear filter popover as a faithful Japanese localization. Preserve the extremely tall narrow portrait composition of the exact 262 by 860 pixel crop (0.305:1). Keep a slim white rounded menu panel almost the full height and width, with a very subtle border and shadow. Do not widen it into a desktop menu or add the issue list behind it. Keep all options visible in one vertical column.

At the top, make a compact search field with the placeholder 「フィルターを追加...」 and a small outlined keyboard keycap 「F」 aligned at the right. Add a thin divider. Then show the first two menu actions in order: 「AIフィルター」 with a small sparkle/filter icon, then 「詳細フィルター」 with a small sliders icon. Add a divider after these two actions.

Below, show these exact filter rows in this exact order, each in a compact row with its matching small muted-gray icon on the left and a small right-pointing chevron at the far right:
1. 「ステータス」
2. 「担当者」
3. 「エージェント」
4. 「作成者」
5. 「優先度」
6. 「ラベル」
7. 「関連」
8. 「おすすめラベル」
9. 「日付」
Insert a thin divider.
10. 「プロジェクト」
11. 「プロジェクトのプロパティ」
Insert a thin divider.
12. 「フォロワー」
13. 「自動クローズ」
14. 「内容」
15. 「リンク」
16. 「テンプレート」

Use the source icon concepts: dotted status ring, person for assignee, agent mark, creator silhouette, ascending priority bars, tag shapes for labels, relation flag, tag for suggested label, calendar, project cube, project-property cube, bell, circled x for auto-closed, text square, link, and template page. Preserve subtle gray separators after Advanced filter, Dates and Project properties. Keep row height close to 40 pixels, left icon alignment around 20 pixels, text around 14 pixels, and right chevrons around 12 pixels from the edge. Use compact Linear-style typography, charcoal text and pale-gray icons. No extra rows, selection highlight, decorative artwork, additional text or colors. Preserve the narrow 262 by 860 composition exactly.
reviewNotes: Faithful Japanese filter popover with search and F shortcut, AI and advanced actions, and all 16 filter rows in source order with correct group dividers and chevrons. ImageGen raw canvas 725x2169 was framed by trimming only outer blank margins and applying a 2.6% horizontal normalization; final 661x2169 (0.30475:1) matches 262x860 (0.30465:1) within 0.1%. Side-by-side inspection confirms no clipped rows; canonical reopen and registration checks complete.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
